title: Return fresh tagged evidence with stale edit failures
hypothesis: Attaching a bounded current tagged source window to an edit rejected for stale tags lets Sol preserve concurrent changes and retry directly, removing the explicit recovery read and sometimes a model round without weakening stale-write safety.
falsified_if: Any treatment run loses behavior, concurrent annotations, scope, or verification; treatment performs a focused source read after the stale failure as often as control; mean model calls do not improve; or latency and prompt tokens both regress by more than ten percent.
decision_rule: Adopt only if every treatment run passes, the current tagged window materially reduces recovery reads, and model calls or latency improve without a greater than ten percent regression in the other.
